svg.desc: Data pipeline: download to a .part file, verify the checksum (refuse on mismatch), read with only empty fields as missing, check the data contract (which reports issues), investigate each defect, clean with one stated decision each, and re-validate.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each step either proves something or records a decision.
